messages:
leah_cs: heads-up: i'm running a small calibration on onboarding-queue signals tomorrow. goal: validate that our playbook isn't firing on accounts that just missed a tutorial step. want a 150-sample manual review. anyone object? :mag:

vic_eng: fine by me. what's the query? recommend including owner_exists AND created_at > 90_days to avoid ancient records.

leah_cs: using this seed: onboard_steps_completed <= 2 AND last_activity_at < now() - interval '21 days' AND has_owner = true LIMIT 150. adding healthscore < 45 to tighten.

noah_ops: for the manual run i'll tag results `cs:queue-cal` and add export cols: owner, primary_contact, last_touch_channel, open_tasks_count. reviewers will mark `no_action`, `nudge_email`, `escalate_ae`.

vic_eng: when we convert to auto, please use segment-aware thresholds (bottom 25% per ARR band) and a 48h soft-queue hold for human validation. collect false_positive_rate and avg_time_to_first_action.

leah_cs: great. scheduling a 20-min calibration Thu 9am to align reviewers on rubric. i'll own the runbook and CSV template.

csbot: Reminder set: "Onboarding queue signal calibration" Thu 09:00. Invite sent. :calendar:
